body.statement: Put \(t=\min\{\gamma,\alpha+\beta\}\). There exist constants \(C,n_0\), depending only on \(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,d,L\), and a deterministic integer choice of \(m\) such that \(\phi_{n,m}^{(4)}\) has rejection probability at most \(a_0\) uniformly on \(\mathcal H_0\) for every \(n\), and type-II error at most \(b_0\) whenever \(D(P)\ge C n^{-2t/(4t+d)}\) if \(d\le4t\), or \(D(P)\ge C n^{-4t/(4t+3d)}\) if \(d>4t\), for every \(n\ge n_0\). Its arithmetic cost is \(O(n+J)\) and its memory cost is \(O(J)\).
body.justification: This explicit envelope demonstrates feasibility in every occupancy regime while keeping its possible sparse-bin suboptimality visible.
body.gap: NeykovBalakrishnanWasserman2021 uses binned degenerate statistics for conditional independence, but not a profiled fourth-order CATE energy with separate propensity and baseline smoothness.
body.consumer: The proposition provides a directly implementable conservative detector while the sharp multiresolution frontier is derived.
